title: The Informer's Offer
text: A man in a rival House's colours finds each House's camp alone in the night, slipping between the tents without a sound. To each he makes the same offer, in the same soft voice: tell him the others' weakness, and he will see you are paid for it.

options.label: Send him away into the dark, and trust the others to do the same.

outcomes.text: He shrugs and goes. Everyone sent him away, it seems. He looks tired, and a little disappointed in you all.
He goes, and in the morning your Scions find that someone has told him exactly where to cut. Trust was a poor shield.

options.label: Tell him what he wants to hear. Every House would do the same, given the chance.

outcomes.text: He pays in old silver, warm from his hand. Nobody will ever know, unless he tells them.
He pays you, and he pays the others for the same, and goes off laughing into the night with all of your secrets.
